comment: * The helper class to manage the publish request parameters.

variables.name: mIsPublishing
variables.comment: Used to check whether the publish request is running now.

methods.name: public long generatePublishTaskId()
methods.comment: * @return A unique task Id for this request.

methods.name: public long getCurrentTaskId()
methods.comment: * @return The current valid PUBLISH task ID.

methods.name: public void setPublishingFlag(boolean flag)
methods.comment: * Set the publishing flag to indicate whether it is executing a PUBLISH request or not.

methods.name: public boolean isPublishingNow()
methods.comment: * @return true if it is executing a PUBLISH request now.

methods.name: public void setPendingRequest(@PublishTriggerType int triggerType)
methods.comment: * Set the flag to indicate there is a pending request waiting to be executed.

methods.name: public void clearPendingRequest()
methods.comment:
* Clear the flag. It means a new publish request is triggered and the pending request flag
     * can be cleared.

methods.name: public boolean hasPendingRequest()
methods.comment: * @return true if there is pending request to be executed.

methods.name: public Optional<Integer> getPendingRequestTriggerType()
methods.comment:
* @return The trigger type of the pending request. If there is no pending request, it will
     * return Optional.empty

methods.name: public void setLastPublishedTime(Instant lastPublishedTime)
methods.comment:
* Set the time of the last successful PUBLISH request.
     * @param lastPublishedTime The time when the last PUBLISH request is success

methods.name: public void increaseRetryCount()
methods.comment: * Increase the retry count when the PUBLISH has failed and need to retry.

methods.name: public void resetRetryCount()
methods.comment: * Reset the retry count when the PUBLISH request is success or it does not need to retry.

methods.name: public void resetState()
methods.comment:
* Reset the retry count and related time when the publication status has
     * changed to not_published.

methods.name: public boolean isReachMaximumRetries()
methods.comment: * Check if it has reached the maximum retry count.

methods.name: public boolean isPublishAllowedAtThisTime()
methods.comment: * Check if the PUBLISH can be executed now.

methods.name: public void updatePublishingAllowedTime(@PublishTriggerType int triggerType)
methods.comment:
* Update the PUBLISH allowed time with the given trigger type.
     * @param triggerType The trigger type of this PUBLISH request

methods.name: public Optional<Long> getPublishingDelayTime()
methods.comment: Get the delay time to allow to execute the PUBLISH request.
